question:
The given bar graph shows the total number of wireless keyboards (in thousands) produced by five different branches of a company, B1, B2, B3, B4 and B5, in 2015 and 2016. Study the graph and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/308e9b8233b17a1666881539d6d8a55c5dbb4c7705a781fb8c9caf8f2da928a8.png] 

The number of wireless keyboards produced by branch B4 in 2016 is equal to that produced by which branch in 2015?
